# Create reproduction<AvailableFrom v="4.0.88" />

Create a ZIP that you can submit to Remotion if asked for a reproduction.

## CLI flag

```text
--repro
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#repro)
